n_idea0.text:
THE LOOSH ECONOMY
Eight units hunt Loosh but nobody is in it. Make it a market: the Banker runs the exchange for the Overlord, the Gambler pays his debt in loosh, the Televangelist and the E-Girl are suppliers, the Popstar is product. A DOOR case: follow the money to Hell.

n_idea1.text:
THE STADIUM STRIKE
The President nuked the stadium: the QB wants revenge, the Sewer Gator becomes the Kaiju, King Kong rivals it. Add: the Firefighter pulled the QB out, the Referee was paid (by the Gambler) to stall the game, and the female Politician runs against the President with the QB at her side.

n_idea2.text:
HELL'S ROYAL FAMILY
Prince in the mailroom, Princess who hates the Succubus, and their father the Overlord sending memos to the Doorman. Who inherits? The Openers + Legion alliance gives the Prince a way to prove himself on Earth.

n_idea3.text:
THE GREYS GO ROGUE
The Jellyfish made the Greys as workers; the Greys sided with the MIC; every farmer, cowboy, scarecrow and Mantid hates them. Arc: the Jellyfish UFO comes to take its workers back and the General is caught in the middle.

n_idea4.text:
ELLE'S MARRIAGE
Elle Vator is married to the Tech CEO, who loves the Spy, who serves the Shogun, who employs the Hacker. The affair is a Katana Empire honey-trap to get into the Tech CEO's company (and DOOR, through Elle).

n_idea5.text:
THE ESCAPEES' INSIDE MAN
The D.U.M.B. Janitor saw every lab and left the door open. The Power Trio hunts the Escapees; the Telepaths and the Catgirl hate the Mad Scientist. His rival is the female Mad Scientist (ex-CERN) who wants another 1971 crossing.

n_idea6.text:
STILL ALONE
No ties at all: Cosmic Wraith, Boltzmann Brain, Occulus, Djinn, Wendigo, Chess Piece, Luchador, Firefighter, Influencer... Also missing from the board: Android, Skinwalker, Droid, Chosen One, Super Sentai, Door Agent. The Black Cube faction has no members; Peace had one.
